stages.label: Universities in the subset
stages.what: A configured list of universities (domains from the Hipo university-domains list).

stages.label: Pages fetched
stages.what: A site-restricted web search finds candidate pages; each is fetched politely (robots.txt, rate limit, no logins) and snapshotted.

stages.label: ML course pages found
stages.what: A page counts as an ML course if its title names machine learning (or deep/statistical learning, pattern recognition) and it shows at least three course signals (syllabus, lecture, exam, grading...).

stages.label: Course offerings / distinct courses
stages.what: Title, code, term, level and instructor are read from each course page; offerings of the same course are merged into one distinct course.

stages.label: References extracted
stages.what: Book mentions are matched to a hand-curated catalogue of canonical textbooks (title, author, ISBN, link); citation-like lines with no match are kept as unmatched.

stages.label: Material links found
stages.what: Links on course pages are classified as slides, lecture notes, video, homework, solutions or exams.

stages.label: Materials downloaded
stages.what: Public slides and lecture notes (PDF/PPTX only) are downloaded politely: robots.txt, 1 request/s per host, 50 MB per file, no logins; out of the eligible distinct links.
